name: Focus Lighting & Fixtures Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2005, Focus Lighting & Fixtures Limited is engaged in manufacturing and trading of innovative LED lights and fixtures. [1]
keyPoints:
Product Mix H1 FY25
1) Retail & Home Lighting (98%): The company offers a range of spotlights and downlights including Array Pro, Dione Cove, Elite, EOS, Magnus, NIX, Perdu, etc. [1] [2]

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 47.6% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 25.3%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -17.4%
